title: Exception Report — every flag, City of North Tonawanda
notice: One row per flag; each is a question, not a finding. The dollar column mixes two kinds of figure - read figure_basis on every row: an annual filing line (revenue or spending, as filed with the NYS Comptroller, not audited) or a claim the city approved, not necessarily paid. The sections overlap and revenue sits beside spending: never add the figures together. An unsolicited sample built from public records, not requested by or produced for the City of North Tonawanda.
